name: Feature request

## Summary

A clear, one-sentence description of the feature.

## Problem it solves

What problem does this address? Who does it help?

## Proposed solution

How would you implement this? What should it look like?

## Alternatives considered

Any other approaches you considered and why you ruled them out.

## Additional context

Any other relevant information.

---

**Before submitting:**
- Check that this does not require cloud storage, a backend, or third-party libraries
- Check that this does not reduce user privacy or change the security model
- Check open issues to avoid duplicates
